== Notes ==
* The fastest way to capture this skill is to start the Raisu Palace mission, as Sword Ancient Kai is near the beginning of the mission.
* This is one of the few Factions elite skills that are obtainable in Nightfall; however, if you do not own Factions, you won't be able to capture it.
* This is one of the skills with the lowest adrenal cost, the others being the monster skills, [[Jadoth's Storm of Judgment]] and [[Ehzah from Above]].
* The adrenaline is also gained on renew.
* Can fuel itself provided that at least 2 seconds lie between activation and the block. Can also maintain adrenaline outside combat if you have atleast 1 strike of adrenaline required to activate the stance, as adrenaline is gained when the stance ends.
